purpose: Measure local evidence-storage and end-to-end offline verification cost, then bind those measurements to the already-prespecified integrity challenge. This protocol does not estimate scientific outcomes or public-chain overhead.

timing.ordinaryHashDefinition: One SHA-256 over sorted relative paths and bytes for every verifier-input file; verification-report.json is excluded.
timing.interpretation: Descriptive on this host only; process startup is included for both verifier commands, filesystem cache state is uncontrolled, and no inferential latency claim is allowed.

storage.payloadLowerBound: UTF-8 JSON serialization of each event content value plus one newline.
storage.ordinaryLogProxy: UTF-8 JSONL containing only stream, sequence, turn when present, eventType, and content, in that key order.
storage.signedStreams: The five stream files declared by run-manifest.json, including hashes, links, key identifiers, signatures where applicable, and witness fields.
storage.capturedDirectory: Every captured file, including the pre-existing verification-report.json.
storage.interpretation: The ordinary-log proxy is a declared storage comparator, not a runnable integrity system. Full-bundle overhead also includes policy snapshots and scientific metadata, so it must not be attributed entirely to cryptography.

utility.interpretation: Observed rejection of one fixture per mutation and implementation is a deterministic software challenge, not a statistical detector-sensitivity estimate.
